async def act(page):
    # Locate the homepage URL field; common labels might be 'Homepage' or 'Website'
    # Try to find by role 'textbox' with name containing 'homepage' (case-insensitive)
    homepage_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Homepage', exact=False)
    if await homepage_field.count() == 0:
        # If not found, try 'Website' or other variations
        homepage_field = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Website', exact=False)
    if await homepage_field.count() == 0:
        # Use get_by_label as an alternative
        homepage_field = page.get_by_label('Homepage', exact=False)
    if await homepage_field.count() == 0:
        homepage_field = page.get_by_label('Website', exact=False)
    # Fill the field with the desired URL
    await homepage_field.first.fill('www.byteblaze.com')
    # Locate the save button; common names are 'Save changes' or 'Save profile'
    save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save changes', exact=False)
    if await save_button.count() == 0:
        save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save profile', exact=False)
    # Click the save button
    await save_button.first.click()
    # Wait for any network activity to settle
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # No further actions needed as the task should be complete
